post.description:
Finding Taiwan public tenders by keyword, agency or case number, or listing notices published in a date window; then call tender_detail with a result's pk.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

case_no.description: Agency case number (標案案號), e.g. CGH115032. The site allows a case-number search without a date window.

category.description:
Procurement category (採購性質): works=工程類, goods=財物類, services=勞務類. Default all.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "works", "goods", "services"].

date_type.description:
Date filter: today (當日 notices), open_for_bidding (等標期內, deadline not yet passed), range (公告日期 between start_date and end_date). Default: range when start_date or end_date is given, otherwise today. Ignored when only case_no is used.

Provider reference: allowed values ["today", "open_for_bidding", "range"].

end_date.description: Notice date window end, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Taipei). Pattern: ^\d{4}[-/]\d{2}[-/]\d{2}$.

org_id.description: Agency code (機關代碼) from lookup_agency, e.g. 3.13.31.25 or A.17.1.

page.description:
1-based page number; use the previous call's next_page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000.

page_size.description:
Rows per page; the site offers 10, 20, 50 or 100. Default 50.

Provider reference: allowed values ["10", "20", "50", "100"].

start_date.description: Notice date window start, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Taipei). Pattern: ^\d{4}[-/]\d{2}[-/]\d{2}$.

tender_name.description: Keyword matched against the tender name (標案名稱), e.g. 資訊系統.

tender_type.description:
Notice type: tender (招標公告, default), appeal (公開徵求), public_read (公開閱覽), forecast (政府採購預告).

Provider reference: allowed values ["tender", "appeal", "public_read", "forecast"].

tender_way.description:
Tendering method (招標方式); default all. open=公開招標, e_quotation=公開取得電子報價單, quotation_or_proposal=公開取得報價單或企劃書, restricted_evaluated=經公開評選或公開徵求之限制性招標, selective_list=選擇性招標(建立合格廠商名單), selective_list_invite=選擇性招標(後續邀標), selective_case=選擇性招標(個案), e_bidding=電子競價, restricted=限制性招標(未經公開評選).

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "open", "e_quotation", "quotation_or_proposal", "restricted_evaluated", "selective_list", "selective_list_invite", "selective_case", "e_bidding", "restricted"].
